method: Official URLs were opened with fetch_page and read at field level. Source excerpts were transcribed into this ledger before canonical values were changed. No missing value was inferred; EUR was not converted to USD; sold and variant prices are labeled by their actual basis.
timeNote: Only the retrieval date is asserted for fetches. A time is recorded only when the source itself displayed it (notably Kitco).
noHallucinations: Blank means unverified. A source conflict is published, not resolved by preference. Derived values must be recomputed from the canonical inputs.

checks.subject: FTC jewelry buying guidance
checks.sourceExcerpt: Near the karat quality mark, look for the name or US registered trademark of the company behind it; if there is no trademark with the karat mark, FTC says do not buy. Solid gold means not hollow. Return policies should be obtained in writing.

checks.subject: eCFR 16 CFR Part 23
checks.sourceExcerpt: eCFR displays Title 16 up to date as of 10/21/2026 and last amended 10/19/2026. Part 23 includes §23.3 gold content, §23.10 quality marks and §23.18 weight representations.

checks.subject: 15 USC 295 gold fineness tolerance
checks.sourceExcerpt: Actual fineness may not be more than three one-thousandth parts below the mark on the tested solder-free part; for the entire article including solder, seven one-thousandth parts applies to articles other than watchcases or flatware.

checks.subject: 16 CFR 23.3 gold-content representations
checks.sourceExcerpt: Misrepresenting the presence, quantity or karat fineness of gold is unfair or deceptive. The rule also says hollow-center products should not be described as solid gold.

checks.subject: 15 USC 297 identifying trademark
checks.sourceExcerpt: Section 297(b) requires the identifying trademark or name to be applied by the same means, at least as large, and as close as possible to the quality mark.

checks.subject: NIST troy-ounce conversion
checks.sourceExcerpt: Appendix B.8 lists ounce (troy or apothecary) to gram as 3.110348 E+01 (rounded display). The calculator retains Kitco's more precise stated 31.1034768 g/ozt constant and labels that source separately.

checks.subject: LBMA precious-metal benchmark process

checks.subject: FTC credit-card disputes
checks.sourceExcerpt: FTC explains the right to dispute billing errors and separately addresses complaints about the quality of goods and services.

checks.subject: Etsy Purchase Protection
checks.sourceExcerpt: Full refund for qualifying orders that do not arrive, arrive damaged, arrive 7+ days after the maximum estimated delivery window, or differ significantly from description/photos. Other dissatisfaction is directed to the seller's return policy.

checks.subject: JVC jewelry-dispute mediation
checks.sourceExcerpt: JVC offers a jewelry-purchase dispute mediation program for consumers and trade members; acceptance depends on resources, eligible submissions, viable claims and supporting evidence.

checks.subject: FTC Report Fraud
checks.sourceExcerpt: Official portal for reporting fraud, scams and bad business practices; reports are shared with law-enforcement partners, but FTC does not resolve individual reports.
